svg.title: TheGeekDogs
svg.desc: The navbar wordmark's dog head in the social brand's colours (docs/social/DESIGN.md): off-white #FBFBFD ground, orange #FF6B1A ears, near-black #1D1D1F outline and muzzle. Hard-coded so the tile reads the same in either scheme. No glow: the PNGs are palette-quantised and a gradient would band. scripts/build-icons.mjs exports the PNGs from this file.
